notes.title: Version 1.3 Patch
notes.content:
Release Notes 1.3:

* Straddle operations get more complex as you progress
* Straddle motor has more torque at the low end, allowing for creeping
* Truck brakes have been tuned for faster response
* More sightings of a troublemaker character
* Internal preparation for new story content
